cds.title: University of Hawai'i at Manoa Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF)

snapshot.title: UH Manoa Admissions - Freshman admission snapshot, fall 2025 admitted class

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2024 first-year class); it gives no residency split and does not report the SAT/ACT percentiles or the share of students who sent scores. Undergraduate counts are the Common Data Set totals (15,375 undergraduates, of whom 551 are nonresident). Student-faculty ratio 13.4:1 (Common Data Set). The newer fall 2025 class, with a residency split, is in the second statistics row.

stats_extra.notes: From UH Manoa's published fall 2025 admitted-class snapshot: Hawaii residents 5,354 applied / 4,808 admitted / 1,933 enrolled; U.S. out-of-state (not WUE) 4,099 / 3,387 / 360; WUE states 7,541 / 6,806 / 973; international 395 / 301 / 53 enrolled. Out-of-state here is the sum of non-WUE and WUE applicants (11,640 applied, 10,193 admitted). Admitted-student GPA 25th-75th percentile 3.49-4.04. The SAT (1130-1350) and ACT (21-29) ranges loaded for this college are the 25th-75th percentiles of admitted students from the same page, not of enrolled students.

cds_test_policy.notes: UH Manoa is test-optional with a 'Do No Harm' policy: a submitted score that would hurt the applicant is excluded.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set: 255 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received aid from the college itself (avg $16,080, total $4,100,332); it does not make clear which aid year this covers and counts all nonresidents, not only international students
